get.description: Owner-derived cache-aside snapshot. A miss or stale snapshot returns 503 with Retry-After after durably scheduling an asynchronous refresh.

schema.description: AUTHORIZED requires true/true and no rejectionReason. REJECTED requires a nonblank rejectionReason and either two boolean checks or both checks omitted/null. Omitted/null checks are the gated unclassified-rejection capability.

post.description: Classified entry decisions remain available. Unclassified REJECTED decisions are implemented but disabled by default; while disabled they return 503 before creating an operation.

503.description: Unclassified entry rejection is disabled; no operation was created

get.description: Side-effect-free exact local read of one current or historical Wash execution. The path identifier is the only selector; no current-service-date filter or fallback appointment is applied. The response does not grant command permissions.

503.description: Required local projection is unavailable or incomplete

post.description: STUDENT_ENROLLMENT and QR lookups are implemented as side-effect-free local reads. QR is disabled by default through BFF_WASH_QR_ENABLED and returns 503 until the flag is enabled and recovery is READY for the service date; unknown or revoked QR values return 404.

get.description: Side-effect-free local read of an owner-ranked snapshot. Missing, stale, future-dated, version-mismatched, or unready material returns 503; only an owner-proven empty snapshot returns 200 with candidates=[]. The rollout feature is disabled by default until the Wash Execution Query owner is deployed.

503.description: Required fresh local snapshot is unavailable
